scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
